map.如何使用上标文字？: How do I use Superscript Text?
map.上标文字适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Superscript Text best for?
map.💡 自动将数字转为上标/下标 Unicode 字符。也可手动选择转换模式。: 💡 Automatically converts digits to superscript/subscript Unicode characters. You can also choose the conversion mode manually.
map.自动（所有字母数字转上标）: Auto (all letters and digits to superscript)
map.化学式与数学公式展示：把指数、阶码转为上标形态（如 x²、CO₂ 的 2 用上标: Showing chemical and mathematical formulas: turn exponents and orders of magnitude into superscript form (e.g. the 2 in x² or CO₂).
map.脚注与修订标记：在正文标注上标序号，对应文末注。: Footnotes and revision marks: add superscript numbers in the body referencing endnotes.
map.单位与版本号：如 m²、v2 的轻量展示。: Units and version numbers: lightweight display such as m² or v2.
map.输入「x2」，上标模式输出「x²」；也可用上标数字区块直接展示，适合化学式 H₂: Entering "x2", superscript mode outputs "x²"; it can also be shown directly using superscript digit blocks, suiting cases like H₂O or area m² that need no formula environment.
map.上标和普通小字区别？: How do superscripts differ from ordinary small text?
map.上标码位（² ¹ ⁿ），排版位置更高且不被当作普通数字参与计算；普通缩小的字只是: superscript code points (² ¹ ⁿ), sit higher in typesetting and are not treated as ordinary digits in calculations; merely shrinking a font only changes its appearance.
map.所有数字都有上标吗？: Do all digits have superscript forms?
